title: Tavi’s Dinosaur Ramp Rally
credit: Original story and SVG illustrations created for Axiom Play Studios with OpenAI Codex.

scenes.narrative: Tavi the young triceratops has a little red delivery cart and six leafy parcels for the dinosaur rally. Fern waits at the near stop; Bronto waits farther along. “Can one track serve both neighbours?” Tavi wonders. We can try two tilts of the same hinged ramp in this on-screen illustrative model. Real carts and surfaces can behave differently.
scenes.alt: Tavi, a mint-green triceratops with three cream horns and a golden neckerchief, stands with long-necked Bronto beside a red parcel cart and a rally delivery table.

scenes.narrative: Fern the little dinosaur waits by the near marker with a basket of ferns. Tavi puts one leafy parcel in the red cart. “I wonder where it will stop from the lower starting point,” he says. Choose a ramp tilt and make a prediction before the picture trial. The ramp length, cart and ground stay the same; lifting the ramp raises its start and makes its tilt steeper.
scenes.alt: A leafy parcel rides in the red cart. The lower and higher ramp supports lead down the same length wooden ramp toward Fern’s near marker.

activity.comparison: Compare your saved trials: which ramp tilt did you choose, and where did the cart stop? A higher starting point gives this same cart more energy to roll along this unchanged surface. Our picture model is illustrative; real wheels and surfaces may give different distances.

scenes.narrative: Bronto’s long neck peeks over the far delivery marker. His parcel is the same size as Fern’s, and Tavi keeps the same cart. “The far stop is waiting too,” Tavi says. This time you can try the other ramp tilt, or repeat one you want to see again. First choose what you think will happen.
scenes.alt: The far rollout marker waits for Bronto’s parcel. Both ramp supports and the same red cart remain on the hinged ramp track.

scenes.narrative: Fern has one more leafy parcel to collect. Tavi wants to check the earlier delivery rather than guess from memory. He brings the very same cart back to the very same ramp. “Can we see that stop again?” he asks. Try a ramp tilt, then use Try again if you want to compare it with the other tilt.
scenes.alt: Tavi checks a repeat delivery on the same length hinged ramp, with Fern’s near and Bronto’s far stops both marked.

scenes.narrative: The rally neighbours gather beside the track. In this picture model, the same cart can stop nearby from the gentler ramp’s lower start and farther away from the steeper ramp’s higher start. Tavi can choose a ramp tilt for each delivery. Fern waves a leaf; Bronto nods from the far stop. The parcels can join the rally, and there is always time for another try.

prompts.question: Where did the cart from the steeper ramp stop in this picture model?
prompts.answer: At the farther marker. This was an illustrative model of one cart and surface.

prompts.question: How might Tavi feel while checking a delivery again?
